name: The Haunted Isle
summary: In Booty Bay, Krazek hears a tale of an isle haunted by a goblin ghost. He gathers unusual rumors for Baron Revilgaz, and this one recalls an old troll legend.

sections.title: Tavern Tales in Booty Bay
sections.body: Krazek gathers reports of strange happenings throughout Stranglethorn Vale for Baron Revilgaz. In a Booty Bay tavern, sailors tell him of an isle off the coast where water elementals dwell. They say the ghost of a raving goblin haunts it. Krazek gives little heed to spectral gossip, but this tale catches his attention. He asks you to carry it to the baron.

sections.title: A Troll Legend
sections.body: Baron Revilgaz remembers an old troll legend from a book when he hears Krazek's report. The water elementals and goblin apparition make him suspect that the Stone of the Tides may be within his grasp. He hopes to add the ancient relic to his personal collection of artifacts.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Baron Revilgaz?
faq.answer: Krazek asks you to carry the rumor to Baron Revilgaz after hearing sailors tell an unsettling tale in a Booty Bay tavern.

faq.q: What rumors did the sailors share?
faq.answer: The sailors tell of an isle off the coast where water elementals dwell and the ghost of a raving goblin haunts it.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz care about a ghost story?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz remembers an old troll legend from a book. The reports suggest that the ancient Stone of the Tides may be on the isle.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz points you toward the Stone of the Tides, carrying the pursuit forward.
